valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 core diluted EPS (USD, Novartis reports in USD) viewed at the Nov 2027 target date. ADR conversion: 1 NVS ADS = 1 Novartis AG ordinary share (ADR ratio from the FY2025 Form 20-F ADR footnote that the depositary JPMorgan Chase Bank holds one share per ADR, as returned by search; the cover-page text could not be opened directly, so confirm on the 20-F or the depositary page). Because EPS is reported in USD no FX is applied to the valuation; the ADR value equals the per-share value x 1. FX is only used for CHF analyst targets (SIX line): converted at USD/CHF 0.84 (CHF per USD; Trading Economics, Nov 13 2026 intraday touch, not an official close), i.e. CHF 115 = $136.90, and the same rate is applied to the prior CHF 120 = $142.86.

bear.driver: Generic erosion of Entresto, Tasigna and Promacta outpaces Kisqali, Pluvicto, Scemblix, Cosentyx and Leqvio growth, and the Avidity deal and R&D charges weigh on margin; core EPS falls about 5% from the FY2026 run-rate.

base.driver: 2026 guidance (net sales low single-digit growth; core operating income now low single-digit growth) holds, with 2027 sales growth of about 3-4%, core margin edging toward the 40%+ 2029 goal, and buybacks (up to $4.9bn remaining under the $10bn program) lowering the share count by about 1.5-2% a year.
base.assumption: FY2026E core EPS about $9.20 (9M26 $6.85 plus Q4 about $2.35, my estimate); FY2027E core EPS $9.60 at 17.0x = $163.2

bull.driver: Pipeline and launches (Kisqali, Pluvicto, Scemblix, Leqvio, abelacimab) push mid-term sales growth to the 5-6% CAGR upper end, margin reaches 41-42% early, and buybacks continue.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS $9.60 the close of $160.50 implies 16.7x (17.4x on FY2026E $9.20). The equal-weight USD-equivalent named target of about $152.8 implies 15.9x base EPS, or EPS of about $8.99 at a constant 17x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $9.60 (6.0 pp of price return); $0.10 of FY2027 EPS moves it by $1.70 (1.1 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Core operating income growth and core EPS versus the $9.20 FY2026E run-rate, especially generic erosion of Entresto/Tasigna/Promacta against Kisqali, Pluvicto and Scemblix growth, and the 2027 core margin outlook.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year 2026 results on February 3, 2027 (per the Q3 coverage on Quartr).

analyst_notes: Six named analysts were found (Morgan Stanley, BofA, Deutsche Bank, HSBC, TD Cowen, Berenberg); JPMorgan, UBS, RBC, Jefferies, Bernstein and Barclays updates after the Oct 27 Q3 release were omitted because the sources do not name the analyst or give a target. Morgan Stanley raised $156 to $163 and Deutsche Bank downgraded to Sell with a CHF 115 target (about $136.9, cut from CHF 120), while TD Cowen's $180 Hold is Sept and the highest. The equal-weight named target of about $152.8 sits 4.9% below the close, about 6.6 pp under the +1.7% base return, which equals 15.9x versus the 17x base multiple; horizons are undocumented so none enter the weighted target, and three of the five targets predate the Q3 release. MarketScreener shows a Hold consensus of 23 analysts averaging $153.93.
